title: The Brooklyn Toy Store at the Center of the Kelly Clarkson Online Frenzy
summary: Art of Play, a novelty store in Brooklyn Heights, has found itself at the center of a social media maelstrom over a feud between the shop and the singer and TV personality Kelly Clarkson.
